name: Caleruega (Spain)
description: White field with a red stripe near the top and a green stripe near the bottom, each one tenth of the height, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Caleruega (a cross, a dog with a torch and a tower).
history: The flag, formed from the three basic colours of the arms, is entirely white charged with a red stripe and a green stripe of 1/10 of the width, placed at a distance equal to their thickness from the upper and lower edges respectively, with the arms of the town at its heart.

features.role: Caleruega arms — cross, dog with a torch and tower
